definition: The ASR accuracy metrics: edit distance (substitutions + insertions + deletions) divided by reference length, at word or character level.
details: The ASR accuracy metrics: edit distance (substitutions + insertions + deletions) divided by reference length, at word or character level. CER is fairer for morphologically rich or space-ambiguous languages; for Arabic, always report whether diacritics and normalization were applied, or numbers are not comparable.
